## Purpose
Applies the Frontend & Design settings to the running app: theme tokens, fonts, text scale, tab title and API timeout. It renders nothing. It also owns day/night mode.

## Responsibilities
- Reads `useServerUi`. `effectiveUiConfig`, then `applyUiConfig(cfg, resolvedTheme)`, then `writeUiCache`.
- Sends the Settings default colour mode to `themeStore.setDefault`, and re-applies the tokens when the resolved theme flips.
- Sets the axios timeout from `UI_API_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`.
- Keeps the tab title correct with `applyTitle` (product name and renamed pages) as pages set their own titles on navigation.
- Shift+Alt+L cycles the colour mode on any page.

## Key elements
`AppConfigApplier`.

## Control flow
React rendering; data through React Query hooks where noted.

## Data, state and side effects
Writes styles, tags and the title onto the document, and the localStorage cache.

## Configuration
The UI_* settings from `/api/settings/public`.

## Interactions
- Uses `lib/uiConfig`, `lib/theme` and `layout/nav-items.tabRenames`. Mounted by `routes/__root`.

## Error handling and edge cases
None noted.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **The cache is read in an effect, not during render,** so the server render is unaffected.
- **Saving on the Settings page refetches the public config,** so changes land at once.

## How to rebuild this file
Implement as described; copying the file is the reliable route for exact styling.

None.
